summary: Porting a mid-size CLI tool from Zig to Rust, module by module

architecture.backend: n/a — CLI; modules ported in dependency order, leaf crates first
notes: each Zig module became one Rust module with a parity test

workflows.notes: probe CLI commands, fix unique panic locations

outcome.note: panic-sweep hit MAX_ROUNDS once before targets were deduped

lessons: Deduping panics by source location instead of by failing command meant one fix per root cause, not one per symptom.
Verify-until-dry inside each round caught bugs that earlier fixes exposed, without running a fixed number of passes.
Adversarial verify rejected several 'fixes' that suppressed a crash with an early return instead of solving it.
pitfalls: Without a MAX_ROUNDS cap an early panic-sweep loop would not terminate; capping it and reporting non-convergence surfaced a genuinely hard module.
